title: Treasury liquidity-support buyback operation (10-20Y nominal, 1:40pm ET)
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Buyback Operations (August 2026 refunding, masthead 'For Publication August 5, 2026'), PDF text layer decompressed direct 2026-09-06 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 125,547 bytes, md5 79b65955e74a59f6bebff3adf8ba7b35) — the row reads verbatim announce 9/30/2026, operation 10/1/2026 1:40 pm - 2:00 pm, settle 10/2/2026, Liquidity Support, Nominal Coupons 10Y to 20Y, maturity range 10/02/2036 - 10/01/2046, min $0, max $2 billion. Stays estimate on three counts: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, its $2B cap is SUPERSEDED (see notes), and the confirming primary is the 09-30 operation announcement rather than this document, checked 2026-09-06
notes: THE PUBLISHED CAP ON THIS ROW IS STALE AND SHOULD NOT BE QUOTED. Press release sb0607 (2026-08-19) states verbatim that Treasury is 'increasing, by at least double, the size of liquidity support buyback operations for longer-dated nominal coupon securities (the 10-year to 20-year sector and the 20-year to 30-year sector). The current maximum size of $2 billion per operation will be at least $4 billion per operation. This change is effective September 9, 2026 and will be in effect for the remainder of this refunding quarter (through November 4, 2026).' So the operative cap here is at least $4B; anyone reading the schedule alone gets a superseded number. sb0607's own 'An updated tentative Treasury buyback schedule will be released at a later date' was still unfulfilled 18 days on (this fetch was byte-identical in size to the 09-03 and 09-05 fetches recorded by the sibling buyback entries). Why it earns a slot: the calendar already tracks the 09-10, 09-24, 10-08, 10-15 and 10-27 long-end operations inside the doubled-size window and skipped this one, leaving a gap in the series that matters most to treasury-buyback-increase-2026-09-09 — the operations the $4B floor actually applies to. It is also the first long-end operation of October and lands the same week as the quarter-turn. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, no house playbook is macro-keyed, and a $0-4B liquidity-support operation is a demand-side mechanic, not a price signal. Discovered during the treasury-buyback-increase-2026-09-09 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-06); the same schedule's 09-15 TIPS, 09-17 7Y-10Y, 09-29 TIPS and 10-21 TIPS operations are outside this event's long-end scope and are deliberately NOT filed here.
